articles.title: Poste Italiane Q3 profit beats forecasts on insurance, payments growth
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Poste Italiane beat third-quarter profit forecasts on Thursday, driven by growth in insurance and payments, but maintained its 2026 standalone targets, as it prepares to integrate newly acquired Telecom Italia (TIM).

articles.title: Italy authorises Bancoposta to take stakes in financial companies
articles.summary: The decree does not allow Bancoposta to hold controlling interests in "banks and financial intermediaries".

articles.title: Is Poste Italiane (BIT:PST) Reasonably Priced Or Looking Stretched?
articles.summary: Poste Italiane has seen its share price move a long way in recent years, which naturally raises the question of whether the current €24.46 level is still aligned with what its earnings can support. With that kind of run behind it, the valuation debate now centers on how much of the business performance is already reflected in the price. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned about 214.8%. Anyone looking at Poste Italiane today is effectively asking how much of that earnings story is...

articles.title: Telecom Italia shares fall as Poste misses 90% threshold to delist stock
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Telecom Italia shares fell on Monday after Poste Italiane’s tender offer closed with the group holding 85.82% of the company, short of the 90% needed to delist the stock.

articles.title: Telecom Italia reports growth in second quarter earnings
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Telecom Italia posted second-quarter core earnings on Wednesday that matched analyst expectations, with growth in its Brazilian unit and enterprise division alongside a return to growth in its domestic market.

articles.summary: The selected participants for digital euro pilot include banks and non-bank providers.

articles.title: Special delivery: Italy's postman joins the AI infrastructure race
articles.summary: Italy has picked an unlikely champion to develop its technology infrastructure and protect digital sovereignty: its national postman. Poste Italiane, the postal service which pays out pensions through 12,600 post offices that are as much a feature of remote towns as the local church, is betting on its €13.5 billion ($15.4 billion) bid for ‌Telecom Italia (TIM) to accelerate its shift into digital, telecom and cloud services. Over the past ‌decade it has signed up 30 million users - around 70% of the total - to Italy's digital ID system to access public services online.
